dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: I'm sure you've tried the Roulette Special already, hmm? In a place like this, if anything's worth recommending, it'd be the drinks, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Tapani
dialogues.text: If you're tired and craving real food, swing by Speranza. Ahem... Not that I'm biased just because it's run by our folks. No misunderstandings, eh?
